nodes.label: Weighted-gate structure-variety engine (rollRare)
nodes.rationale: rare_structure_chance present -> weighted pick over weight/requires/explorable fields + Lookup.modLoaded + Explore reward-floor filter; absent -> legacy byte-identical output. Backward-compatible opt-in. D3 Explore reward-floor: the premium seed never forces a loot-less build; D4: mod builds stay derelict so loot never leaks a gate-key (AE2 sky stone/presses, MA prosperity, Upgrade Orb). D5 large/huge rate settled = flat 5% on all sizes.

nodes.label: Inert-safe mod-gating pattern
nodes.rationale: Modded content is gated on Lookup.modLoaded / hasTemplatePool inert-guard and gametest-guarded so content stays inert (skips) when its mod is absent instead of hard-erroring; the void never generates anything on its own — every resource reaches the player only through a grown island seed.

nodes.label: Gated island-tier system
nodes.rationale: Each content mod gets a gated island tier unlocked at the pace of progression, plus a quest chapter (#19/#20 rolling riders); resources appear at low/mid/high throw depths so nothing is a one-time find.

nodes.label: FTB smart-filter tag-task trap
nodes.rationale: FTB smart-filter item tasks don't expand tags — use an advancement task instead when a task must accept a whole tag.

nodes.label: Island-friendly rebuilds (Frozen Warren / War Barrow / Mage's Sanctum)
nodes.rationale: Oversized Iron's structures re-scaled to island tiers: icebreaker->huge + custom boat, wizard->huge_rocky, mangrove->lush_large; trial-chamber-pattern rebuilds Ice Spider Den=Frozen Warren, Battleground=War Barrow, Citadel=Mage's Sanctum. Open: keep Mage's Sanctum rebuild vs. an unbuilt huge_citadel giant tier (leaning keep).
